cim: HSBC expands artificial intelligence footprint across Asia with new Hong Kong institute
cim_eredeti: HSBC expands artificial intelligence footprint across Asia with new Hong Kong institute
szoveg_eredeti: HSBC will launch an artificial intelligence and emerging technology institute in Hong Kong by the first quarter of 2027, following a similar venture in Singapore. The expansion reflects banking sector-wide acceleration in AI adoption, which is prompting job cuts at rivals like Citi and Barclays while creating specialist roles. Hong Kong's regulator has announced Project SAGE to establish safeguards for AI agent deployment in finance.
